content.comment_body: I'm looking to assign two different analog signals to an output with a selection option.
I'd like to route either of two analog signals to the output by selecting between them.
You can use the 'Analog-MUX' block for this purpose.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to switch between two analog signal sources for their output in an automation system. There appears to be some uncertainty or lack of awareness about which logic blocks or built-in functions enable this behavior easily. Users expect the solution to be straightforward and discoverable within the system's available options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a simple, effective way to select and route either of two analog signals to the output, ideally using standard or integrated logic blocks within the automation system.
